listing.name: chronozumi3's ship pack
listing.summary: Adds alternate paintjobs for a variety of midline ships with lore tied to the United Stable Chaos faction.
listing.aiSummary: Adds alternate paintjobs for a variety of midline ships with lore tied to the United Stable Chaos faction.

description:
This is a very small midline ship pack mod, with alternate paintjobs for most of the ships.

This is my first mod, so just looking for general feedback about balance or any technical issues I may have missed.

I tried to keep these pretty close to vanilla ships in most respects but would like to know if anything is under-powered or too OP.

MagicLib required for the alternate paintjobs.

Download here:

Chronozumi3's Ship Pack 1.3 (0.98a)

LORE:

SpoilerPirate King Mount Angkoa was the leader of a successful pirate organization that flourished in the aftermath of the Collapse. Angkoa had a way with words, which generated near-fanatical loyalty with his crews and helped him build and consolidate power. While rival pirate leaders squabbled and betrayed each other, Angkoa’s charismatic leadership let him achieve legendary status among pirates.

After decades of plundering vulnerable settlements and unprotected outposts, Angkoa had amassed a considerable fleet and established a home base on the edge of the Persean sector. He named his colony United Stable Chaos, and purposed his amassed fortune towards defense and commerce. Distance from the core worlds has kept USC out of reach of the Hegemony so far, although their increasing market presence is attracting interest from other factions.

Today USC is controlled by Sanethos, a veteran logistics officer with an extraordinary awareness of economics. The revolutionary concept of trading with people instead of killing them has made him even more popular than his predecessor. Sanethos has made considerable effort to evolve his sprawling pirate haven into a civilized, lawful commonwealth, and almost certainly has nothing to do with Angkoa’s sudden disappearance.

Sanethos founded United Stable Chaos Shipyards, which produce a line of capable midline ships.[close]
